thread:
Jamie (CS): Morning team — kicking off Vantage Retail onboarding. Quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and a light 30/60/90 timeline. Can we confirm owners?
Oliver (Vantage Retail): Thanks Jamie — I'm Oliver, head of AI for Vantage. I'll own internal approvals + data access.
Jamie (CS): Awesome — putting down a proposed owners list:
- Jamie (CS): overall success lead, enablement sessions
- Leo (Solutions): integration & infra runbook
- Maya (PM): product QA & acceptance
- Oliver: approvals, data samples, internal rollout
Does that look right?
Leo (Solutions): yep, I'll take infra. ETA for initial test harness by EOW next week?
Maya (PM): EOW works for a smoke test. Can we get a small set of sample prompts + expected outputs from Vantage by Wed?
Oliver (Vantage Retail): I'll send a sanitized sample set tomorrow. Also need to confirm legal around PII — we're running in Redwood Dedicated.
Jamie (CS): Noted — I'll loop in security separately but for kickoff: success criteria (proposal):
1) 95% of core flows return < 500ms p95 on Dedicated config
2) Quality: top-1 accuracy for product categorization >= 88% on sample evals
3) Dev enablement: internal devs can run local test harness and a smoke call to Redwood API end-to-end by day 14
4) Rollout: pilot to 3 stores within 60 days without production incidents
Thoughts?
Leo (Solutions): Metrics look reasonable. One ask: can we relax p95 to 600ms if we need quantization tradeoffs? Might need to test.
Jamie (CS): We can add a fallback plan: if p95>500ms in initial trials, fallback policy will route to cheaper model variant with graceful degradation — still counts as success for rollout staging. I'll document that as a risk-mitigation.
Maya (PM): Add acceptance checklist item for regression alerts to be wired into Redwood Console + Pager duty for severity >= S2.
Jamie (CS): Good call. I'll add that.
Oliver (Vantage Retail): High-level timeline looks good. Concern: renewal conversation in 9 months — if we don't hit cost targets (target cost per inference <$0.004), procurement will push for renegotiation. Flagging as a business risk.
Jamie (CS): Thanks — capturing renewal-risk: procurement target cost/unit <$0.004. We'll run Optimize recommendations early and share a monthly cost report.
Leo (Solutions): On enablement: I'll prepare an infra runbook snippet we can paste into their onboarding repo. Example snippet:
```
# Redwood quickstart (sample)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-v1","prompt":"classify: ..."}'
```
Jamie (CS): Perfect — we'll use that in the dev workshop.
Maya (PM): Can we schedule a 60-min enablement workshop in week 2? Hands-on: SDK, evals, and Console walkthrough.
Jamie (CS): Yes — suggest Tue week 2, 10am PT. @Oliver will you confirm?
Oliver (Vantage Retail): Tue works. Please add an agenda: 1) SDK quickstart 2) sample eval run 3) cost analysis demo 4) next steps.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "Vantage Retail — Redwood Onboarding Workshop" Tue 10:00 PT — attendees: Jamie, Leo, Maya, Oliver
Jamie (CS): I'll capture feedback loop: weekly 30-min sync + a short NPS-style survey after week 2 workshop. We'll keep a shared short feedback doc and surface any quality regressions.
Leo (Solutions): Small note on data access: prefer short-lived credentials. Oliver, will you provide S3 pre-signed URLs or grant a deploy role?
Oliver (Vantage Retail): We'll provide pre-signed S3 URLs for the initial sample batch. Need Redwood to confirm retention policy.
Jamie (CS): Redwood retention policy: sample artifacts retained for 30 days by default in Dedicated onboarding, can extend per contract. I'll confirm in follow-up.
Maya (PM): Risks log quick capture: list below — please react with :+1: when agree or add emoji for new items.
- Procurement cost target <$0.004 per inference
- Legal/PII clearance for sample data
- Potential latency > target for peak loads
- Need for model fine-tuning beyond out-of-box accuracy

Jamie (CS): Next steps (short):
1) Oliver sends sanitized samples (by Wed)
2) Leo spins up test harness + smoke run (EOW)
3) Jamie schedules workshop (Tue week 2) + shares acceptance checklist
4) Maya prepares eval metrics dashboard and alerting config

Oliver (Vantage Retail): Sending samples later today. Thanks everyone. Excited to get started.
Jamie (CS): Great — I'll post a short onboarding checklist doc and the acceptance criteria into the shared drive after this thread. We'll follow up in the weekly sync.
Maya (PM): Linking quick reference: https://redwood.ai/onboarding-playbooks/vantage (draft)
Jamie (CS): Closing loop — anyone want to add anything?
Leo (Solutions): All good from infra side.
Oliver (Vantage Retail): No more from me. Looking forward.
Jamie (CS): Thanks team :rocket:
